council-hall.alt: The Council hall: a tall dark hall of pillars with purple windows and a round glowing floor, two tiny figures standing in the light.
Ruby stands with her hands folded before the dark pillars of the Council hall.

dormitory-roof.alt: At the green rail of the dormitory roof, Guinevere holds her phone out for a selfie with Vexana, a small gold star at each collar.

fannys-cables.alt: A shining blue cable from Fanny's rig pulls tight around an Ender's arm and holds its claw back.
Fanny swings past a huge dark Ender, a glowing blue line curving from her rig and a blade in her hand.
A shining blue cable whips around an Ender's raised claw.

frontline.alt: A battle report card that marks Fanny, Layla and Guinevere as the frontline assault group.

guineveres-drones.alt: One of Guinevere's drones up close: a round gray shell with cat ears, yellow rings in the ears and yellow eyes.
Guinevere hangs high above the city with her fists raised, two cat-eared drones with yellow ring eyes beside her.
Guinevere crouches in a ruined street, one of her cat-eared drones floating at her hand.

guineveres-room.alt: Guinevere stands by her desk in her warm room, with shelves, trophies and a lamp, and the night city outside the window.
Plush animals sit on a red patterned rug beside a bed with a floral cover.
Wooden shelves in a warm room hold trophies, books and a teddy bear.

mother-matrixs-attack.alt: A huge gray Ender looks down over a smoky, ruined city while more Enders stand behind it.

photograph.alt: The framed photograph on a bright lab bench: two smiling scientists in white coats hold a small pink-haired girl between them.
Mr. Bunny sits on the desk beside the framed photograph of two tall people holding a small girl.

ring-of-light.alt: Angela reaches out as a bright pink ring of light circles Ruby in mid air.

team-up-day.alt: Cadets crowd before a large hologram reading The Aspirants Team-Up Day, while Guinevere stands alone at the right.
Vexana and Guinevere stand apart before the large hologram announcing The Aspirants Team-Up Day.

angelas-white-flower.alt: Angela, her suit scuffed from training, smiles with her eyes shut and holds out a small white flower.

hologram-wall.alt: Guinevere stands before the glowing hologram wall, which reads Vexana: Absent.

pink-doll.alt: A small dark-haired Ruby hugs a pink doll to her chest in the dark hall of pillars.

test-ring.alt: A white crescent hangs in the robot arm of the steel test ring in Chang'e's lab.

cosmic-reapers.alt: Rows of identical androids with animal ears stand still in a hall of tall white windows, the Cosmic Reapers.
A line of androids with magenta eyes stands in profile, and among them one girl has blue eyes.

drill-hall.alt: Fanny stands alone in the narrow lit doorway of the drill hall with a blade in each hand, seen from the dark corridor.

fight-over-the-gap.alt: Vexana and Guinevere sweep past each other in the air, her staff and Guinevere's open hand reaching past.
Guinevere rises over the ruined platforms on a tall wing of red and gold light, her two drones blazing beside her.
Under a shaft of pale light, Guinevere falls headfirst between the towers of the city.

storm-citadel-recording.alt: The Storm Citadel recording shows a huge ship of dark blades hanging in a torn red sky, smaller ships swarming around it.

dead-world-under-a-gray-sky.alt: On a dead gray world under a dark sky, a winged woman raises one hand as red stars burn open overhead.

obsidias-pink-star.alt: Obsidia reaches out with a clawed black glove, a pink star blazing at her chest and a dark sun burning behind her.
